# function: datasync_discoveryjob

Builds the ARN for `datasync` `discoveryjob`:

```
arn:${Partition}:datasync:${Region}:${AccountId}:system/${StorageSystemId}/job/${DiscoveryJobId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:datasync:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:system/storage-system-id/job/discovery-job-id
output "datasync_discoveryjob" {
  value = provider::arn::datasync_discoveryjob("storage-system-id", "discovery-job-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
datasync_discoveryjob(storage_system_id string, discovery_job_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `storage_system_id` (String) Value for `${StorageSystemId}` in the ARN template.
1. `discovery_job_id` (String) Value for `${DiscoveryJobId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
